"""实际改坏新增审核代码，并逐次离线执行对应测试，最后恢复原文。"""
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
cases=[
 ('遗漏字母前缀路由','[A-Za-z0-9_]+/','[0-9]+/','test_routes_keep_prefix_aliases_and_reject_external_or_navigation'),
 ('导航误作题目路由','sorted(set(matches)-navigation)','sorted(set(matches))','test_routes_keep_prefix_aliases_and_reject_external_or_navigation'),
 ('接受重复全局号声明','len(matches)==1','len(matches)>=1','test_global_number_is_unique_explicit_metadata'),
 ('只比较字符集合不比较重数',"Counter(given.rstrip('\\r\\n')) == Counter(actual.rstrip('\\r\\n'))","set(given.rstrip('\\r\\n')) == set(actual.rstrip('\\r\\n'))",'test_permutation_preserves_multiplicity_spaces_and_unicode'),
 ('丢弃字符串空格',"given.rstrip('\\r\\n')","given.replace(' ','').rstrip('\\r\\n')",'test_permutation_preserves_multiplicity_spaces_and_unicode'),
 ('负探针错误变成合法原样输出',"print(s + '~')","print(s)",'test_real_probe_programs_have_expected_semantics'),
 ('默认只读错误提交源码','    if submit:','    if True:','test_audit_defaults_to_no_submission_and_records_probe_disagreement'),
 ('错把平台WA当作与题面一致',"receipt['verdict']==wanted",'True','test_audit_defaults_to_no_submission_and_records_probe_disagreement'),
 ('未拒绝已变化的后台输入','common.sha(payload)==expected[name]','True','test_audit_defaults_to_no_submission_and_records_probe_disagreement'),
 ('未校验提交后的表单','common.form_sha(after)==common.form_sha(before)','True','test_audit_defaults_to_no_submission_and_records_probe_disagreement'),
 ('未校验提交后的文件清单','common.listed_files(after,NUMBER)==names','True','test_audit_defaults_to_no_submission_and_records_probe_disagreement'),
 ('未核对题面字段原哈希','    common.audit_statement(before,entry)','    pass','test_audit_defaults_to_no_submission_and_records_probe_disagreement'),
 ('错误计数后台测试写入',"'test_data_writes':0","'test_data_writes':1",'test_audit_defaults_to_no_submission_and_records_probe_disagreement')]
p=Path('scripts/audit_gmyhf_course_spj.py');original=p.read_text();results=[]
try:
 for name,old,new,test in cases:
  assert original.count(old)==1,(name,original.count(old));p.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_course_spj.CourseSpjTests.'+test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'))
  assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode});p.write_text(original)
finally:p.write_text(original)
s=Path(__file__).read_text();Path('collab/gmyhf-course-spj-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'课程/SPJ复核自产程序的离线变异，不提交变异程序到平台。','results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'tested_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(results),'种变异检出，源码恢复')
